text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Lucky 
Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning on visiting an art museum 
after this... What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: If it's okay, can I come with you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Shall we get going, then?

The museum was holding an exhibition 
called 'Jewelry Brands of the World.' It 
seems that was what she had her eye on.
choice_data_list: Ah, there are brands I recognize too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Great, then Trainer-san can enjoy it 
too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Around here, it seems to be jewelry.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, look at this. Such exquisite 
goldwork...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Despite the generous use of gold and 
jewels, it doesn't feel ostentatious at 
all... —Ah, it must be thanks to this 
intricate craftsmanship.
choice_data_list:
You're right! What exquisite flower 
craftwork.
Really! What beautiful flower craftwork.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye. But for a masterpiece this fine, ya 
won't be able to pull it off unless you've 
got the dignity to match.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I too hope to possess a true 
grace that rivals even the finest of 
jewels."
choice_data_list: I still think it'd look good on you, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, flattery won't get ya anything, 
y'know. Though... hehe, thank ya kindly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh, gathering perfume ingredients from 
all over the world... and ordering 
fragrant olive from Japan, is it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The extraction's done by machine... but 
the final fragrance blend comes down to 
human sense of smell, huh."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's science or human sensibility, 
if either one's missin', you just can't 
make proper perfume, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And only after years of relentless 
refinement. It is easy to see how a brand 
becomes part of history.
choice_data_list: Wait, so perfume counts as an accessory?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"They do say 'to wear a fragrance,' after 
all. Isn't it just another way to 
accessorize yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as it's written here, it seems to 
have become a fashion trend among Western 
nobility—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In Japan as well, there has been a 
long-standing tradition of scenting 
garments with incense since ancient times.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
When you put it that way, I can see why 
perfume is considered an accessory, yes.
choice_data_list: I see...! You really know your stuff.

I see...! You're really knowledgeable, 
huh.

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I only picked up the raw 
information and hadn't thought that far 
ahead... I'm simply astounded by her 
insight.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I'm still just a student 
learning the ropes. Though, I do still 
aspire to be a star performer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If ye don't know the origin and cultural 
background of what yer wearin', ye can't 
truly bring out its authentic shine, 
y'know?
choice_data_list:
Me? I just enjoy the fragrance, that's 
all.

Oh, I'm just enjoying the fragrance, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's just my own personal quirk. 
Properly speaking, that is how perfume is 
meant to be enjoyed, after all—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, there's a tester. Let's try out 
the scent.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Nn...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—A faintly sweet, elegant fragrance... 
It's subtle, just the way I like it...

Even the gesture of sampling perfume was 
so refined— one could easily be fooled 
into thinking she was in a palace where 
aristocrats gather.

Having thoroughly enjoyed the exhibits, I 
decided to check out the museum shop 
before leaving.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, let's buy something as a 
souvenir for ourselves before heading 
back.

The prized item sought by one who aims for 
stardom... I wonder if she's buying 
traditional crafts or perfume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's true... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I shall choose this one.
choice_data_list: Huh? ......That?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: Umm... why that?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, 'cause it's real cute, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"You've got that dopey little look on your 
face, it's real charming and downright 
adorable."

—I fully expected her to choose an art 
book, a traditional craft, or perhaps 
perfume, so this came as a surprise. To 
think she had such an age-appropriate side 
to her.
choice_data_list: Glad you found something you liked!
I'm glad you found something you liked!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yeah, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Man, I was terrified it'd sell out while 
we were looking around!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(After all, it's a collab item between a 
popular comedian and an art museum—an 
ultra-rare limited edition!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still, making a beeline for my target 
wouldn't be very star-like. I must remain 
graceful—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I got what I was aiming for~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you sure you don't wanna buy 
anything?
choice_data_list:
Perfume seems like it'd be good for 
everyday use.

Perfume seems like it'd be great for 
everyday use.
Maybe I'll get the same thing!
Maybe I'll buy the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you sure you don't wanna buy 
anything?
choice_data_list:
Perfume seems like it'd be good for 
everyday use.

Perfume seems like it'd be great for 
everyday use.
Maybe I'll get the same thing!
Maybe I'll buy the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why not? In that case, could I look 
for a fragrance that suits you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd love that!
Yeah, please do!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looking at me with such expectant 
eyes... I will put my heart into making 
the selection.

Picking up one of the plushies, I happen 
to notice a rather large card-like tag—
choice_data_list:
(This is a collab product with a 
comedian!)

text_block_list.text:
—I felt like I understood why she chose 
this plushie.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Now we're matching. Fufu.

"Still, bringing that up in front of this 
smile would just be poor taste—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's plushie and mine have slightly 
different faces. That makes them pretty 
cute too, doesn't it?
